learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to build your very own musical instruments using everyday craft materials and make joyful sounds!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Did you know you can make music with craft supplies? Empty bottles, rubber bands, and boxes can be turned into guitars and drums!
A great instrument looks as good as it sounds! We use bright paints, shiny stickers, and colorful ribbons to make our homemade instruments beautiful.
Once we build our instruments, we can shake, tap, and strum them together to create a wonderful musical band with our friends!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Magic Maracas!
fun_activity.instructions: Take an empty plastic bottle, put a handful of dried beans or rice inside, and close the cap tightly. Wrap the bottle in paper and decorate it with bright markers, then shake it to the beat!

quick_recap: ⭐ We can recycle everyday objects to invent our own musical instruments.
⭐ Decorating our instruments makes playing them even more fun.
⭐ Art and music go hand in hand when we craft and play together!
